title: Readmission and Hold-End Terms for Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations
content:
These are the **Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations** terms on where a resident comes back to and how a hold ends, tier by tier.

| Term | Medicaid Hospital Leave Reserved Bed | Medicaid Therapeutic Leave Reserved Bed | Private Pay Hospital Leave Bed Hold | Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold | Medicare Skilled Stay Hospital Leave Bed Hold | Medicare Skilled Stay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Held bed may be assigned to another resident while the hold is in force | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Where a resident returns while the hold is in force | same room | same room | same room | same room | same room | same room |
| Where a resident whose hold ended returns | first available bed in a semi-private room | first available bed in a semi-private room | next available bed | next available bed | next available bed | next available bed |
| Facility-initiated discharge notice required if the center does not readmit | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| When a release stops charges | the day after release; the day of release is the last held day | same | same | same | same | same |
| Advance notice a resident must give to release a hold (days) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Calendar days of written notice before the center may end a private hold whose charges are past due | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| Days a private hold charge must be past due before the unpaid-hold notice may issue | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| A return within the Part A interrupted-stay window resumes the same skilled stay | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Hold ends when the hospital discharges the resident to another setting instead of back to the center | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

The first-available-semi-private-bed right on the two Medical Assistance tiers is the right of Medicaid-eligible residents under 42 CFR 483.15(e)(1). A release needs no advance notice on any tier (0 days).

**Release illustration (hypothetical).** A representative releases a held bed on the 18th of a month. The 18th is the last held day; charges stop from the 19th.
